text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O won the final race, the Centaur Stakes,
and conquered the Summer Sprint Series!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Celebration!
Congratulations on conquering
the Summer Sprint Series!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Honestly, even I'm surprised I was able to pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It must be because I've built up my foundational stamina.
It's all thanks to you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: More than that, you really did your best.
More than that, you did a great job.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I worked super hard!
Race, training camp! Race, training camp! Race!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Summer has ended with astonishing speed.
Going fast is usually a good thing, but... it's a little lonely.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, to celebrate conquering
the Summer Sprint Series,
the two of you should go on a day trip!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Of course! You girls have the Sprinters Stakes coming up too. Make sure to get plenty of rest and refresh yourselves!
choice_data_list: Where would you like to go on a trip, Right O?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Then... in Niigata.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: If you want to win back your summer, Niigata is the place to be.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as expected, it's the absolute best!
Niigata Racecourse's straight track!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My summer memory is the Ibis SD.
I just really wanted to come here one more time.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Then, let's run—
choice_data_list: No. I have to prepare for the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Right now, high-intensity training is continuing. Even if not at full power, it's best to avoid running on the racetrack."
choice_data_list: Instead, let's go somewhere you'd like.
Instead, let's go somewhere you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What is this place?
Trainer, it's a straight. A very long straight!
choice_data_list: The campsite and the straight path through the forest are long straights too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Beyond the beach, the campsite and forest trails are all situated along one long straight path.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Entirely straight. It's like a place made just for me.
You went and found it for me, didn't you?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I just knew you'd love it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy. Truly blessed.
I'm so grateful, I feel like tossing you up in the air in celebration.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —No, we're tossing you in the air!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Well done, Trainer!
Wasshoi! Wasshoi!"
choice_data_list: Waaah! Not so high, go easy on me!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph…… I can see the straight line ahead, yet I cannot run.
How frustrating."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I know! You run, Trainer.
In my place.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I can't go home without running.
So Trainer, teach me how to run at top speed!
choice_data_list: It's no fun to watch! I'm so slow anyway...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"You usually can't be bothered to go all out, can you?
I want to see you when you're truly serious."
choice_data_list: They say she's always giving it her all...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No way. Now you've got me super curious.
I want to see you get totally serious, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I-I don't usually run, so I don't think my body will cooperate...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Even a bicycle is fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Any further resistance would be futile...
Having no other choice, I rented bicycles at the campsite.
choice_data_list: (If that's how it's gonna be... I'll row with all my might!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Use your body weight to start pedaling.
Once you build up speed, just rest your feet on the pedals.
Just pump those thighs up and down and pedal like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Go, go, Trainer!
You can do more! You've still got plenty left in you!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You're not picking up any speed at all!
Give it your all! You can do way better than this!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Huh, already? Your legs are losing their edge.
You're kidding, right? Where was your top speed?
choice_data_list: S-sorry... This is the fastest I can go...
S-sorry... This is the fastest I can go...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Slow. You're late, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"To think you'd be that slow even on a bicycle.
Trainer, are you totally uncoordinated?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that this is just the limit
of non-athlete human physical ability.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I thought I knew, but I never imagined she would be this different from us.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Still, thanks to that, I think I finally understand.
The reason why you teamed up with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: You want to see top-speed running, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It isn't about reaching it with your own legs.
What you want to see is my running."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You desire the same thing as I do.
I wonder why that is.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Faster and faster.
Fast enough to take your breath away――
that is what I wish for.
